title: Staged decommit attenuator and slate provision advisor
author: Aisha Patel
description: Context: Customers running long-lived Dedicated fleets report noisy decommits when spotty infra or transient load drops trigger aggressive scale-downs. This leads to tail latency spikes as in-flight KV cache and warm pools are evicted too quickly. Motivation: Introduce a staged decommit attenuator that applies a graded decay to reservation revocation and a 'slate provision advisor' that suggests gentle prewarm batches before commits are released. Goals: 1) reduce tail latency/regression during scale-down, 2) preserve per-tenant throughput SLAs while freeing capacity, 3) surface actionable telemetry for provisioning decisions. Summary of changes: Implement a new controller modules/decommit/staged_attenuator.go that tracks per-reservation stability windows and computes an attenuation factor based on recent occupancy, seqlen distribution, and tenant-fidelity-scores. Add slate advisor in orchestration/slate_advisor.go which synthesizes warmup plans (small prebake batches + KV prefix retention hints) and exposes proposals via the provisioning API. Wire telemetry hooks: new metrics redwood_decommit_attenuation{stage,tenant} and redwood_slate_suggestion_count; export sampling traces for slow eviction events. Update unit and e2e tests: decommit/staged_test.go, orchestration/slate_advisor_integration_test.go, and add a perf scenario that simulates staggered decommits across 100 tenants. Commits: ["feat(decommit): add staged attenuation algorithm and state machine","perf(slate): batch-aware prebake planner with backoff","test: integration harness for staged decommit scenarios","docs: runbook and operational knobs for attenuation and slate advisor","chore: add telemetry sampling and dashboard json"]. Changed files (high level): ["modules/decommit/staged_attenuator.go","modules/decommit/staged_attenuator_test.go","orchestration/slate_advisor.go","orchestration/slate_advisor_integration_test.go","api/provisioning/v1/suggest_slates.proto","telemetry/metrics_registry.go","console/dashboards/decommit-attenuation.json","scenarios/perf/staged_decommit.scenario.yaml","pkg/util/decay_window.go","docs/runbooks/decommit-attenuation.md","Dockerfile","Makefile","go.mod","go.sum","ci/presubmit/staged_decommit.yaml","scripts/bench/run_staged_decommit.sh","examples/dedicated/README.md","observability/alerts/decommit_rt_increase.alert.yaml","CHANGELOG.md"]. Migration notes: Feature is opt-in per-pool via poolConfig.decommitAttenuation{enabled,stages,base_decay_ms}. Slate advisor proposals are persisted to a small advisory table and can be applied by the autoscaler or by manual operator action. Rollout plan: start as feature-flag gated in dedicated canary pools for 2 weeks, collect attenuation_ratio and cold_warm_reuse_rate, then enable broader rollout. Review conversation highlights: ["Noah: Algorithm looks solid; can we bound memory for stability windows? Author: Added leaky-bucket cap and configurable window-size param","Diego: Telemetry cardinality concern on tenant labels. Author: changed metrics to use sampled labels and aggregated tenant_buckets","Maya: Please add a fast-path for tiny reservations to skip staged phases. Author: implemented short-circuit for reservations <2 concurrent slots (staged_attenuator.go line 112)","Noah: Approve after tests green"]. CI summary: presubmit linters and unit tests passed on first run; e2e perf scenario failed once with noisy variance, tuned warmup backoff and reran; final run: all checks green. Performance notes: In canary fleet the median decommit glide-time increased 220ms (intentional), 95th percentile tail latency for affected tenants dropped by 18%, and overall reclaimed capacity remained within 2% of baseline. Docs and runbook: Added operational section describing how to interpret attenuation_ratio, how to pin pools to aggressive or conservative profiles, and how to surface slate proposals to capacity managers. Merge outcome: squash-merged into main with commit message "staged decommit attenuator + slate provision advisor (A. Patel)". Release notes: "Introduces opt-in staged decommit attenuation and slate provisioning advisor to reduce tail latency on scale-downs and recommend gentle warmup plans before releasing capacity." Operational follow-ups: monitor redwood_decommit_attenuation_stage{0,1,2} and redwood_slate_success_rate for two weeks and be ready to revert via feature flag if regressions appear.
